releases.notes: Adds complete per-site database management with SQL and SQL.GZ import, ready-made Laravel migration, seeder, optimization, cache, and storage-link actions, Composer commands, Queue and Scheduler controls, site health repair, unified progress and cancellation, faster site search actions, and Redis and SQLite repair across every managed PHP version.

Enables PHP intl and exif automatically for Filament and Spatie packages, repairs existing managed PHP runtimes before Composer starts, and routes moved Laravel projects to public/index.php instead of stale index.html placeholders.

Checks PHP, Node.js/npm, Composer, Laravel Installer, Git, Xdebug, MySQL, and every installed managed service for updates in the background, then shows one notification for all available component updates.

Checks for HerdMe updates automatically at startup, clearly notifies you when a newer version is available, and no longer reports that HerdMe is up to date when the online update service could not be reached.

Prevents empty mail and replaced site previews from reporting WebView failures, pins compatible Windows SDK references for reproducible self-contained builds, and fixes the PowerShell 5.1 formatting gate.

Fixes persistent service installation and service-list refresh, writes mail settings directly to each site's .env file, ships a self-contained Windows installer, repairs npm and npx for PowerShell, and improves Artisan and npm command dialogs with suggestions and visible run controls.
